part.text: {"answer":"No. Bh6 loses a bishop for nothing.","judgment":"Your idea has a real goal: trade off the strong bishop on g7. That is a good London thought. But Bh6 only works when you can follow up. Here Black just plays Bxh6 and wins your bishop. You get nothing back. Bh6 also puts the bishop on a weak square with no pawn support.","advice":"Keep developing. After Be2 you can castle next. h3 is also fine, to make luft and prepare Nbd2.
